inputs.text:
Did you see this? Apparently, the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the DHS put on a carefully scripted theater straight out of JFK International Airport on Thursday. They apparently want people to swallow the official narrative of random coincidence and sudden heroism because the Department of Homeland Security happily releases "video footage" showing an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent just happening to "jump into action" when a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line supposedly stopped breathing. 

The message says it is all a managed spectacle designed to manufacture consent and polish the public image of border enforcement apparatuses. It claims the timing, the cameras rolling, and the precise orchestration make it a textbook distraction maneuver to make people love the very agencies tightening the grip of surveillance and control, and warns not to fall for it.
